name: Qwen3.5-2B-Base
notes: Init checkpoint for G0.5. The released config points at qwen3_5_2b_base_processor and matches this model: vocab 248320, 24 layers, hidden size 2048, the 3× linear-attention + 1× full-attention block. Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B is the post-trained instruct model.
convention: lm-evaluation-harness arc_easy, 0-shot: raw 'Question: {question}\nAnswer:' and each choice text as a continuation; argmax of summed log-probability (acc) and of log-probability per character (acc_norm)
